_description: Hand-curated ground-truth (gold standard) test questions for evaluating retrieval quality, NOT generated by an AI. Each question lists the rule citation(s) a good retrieval system SHOULD surface in its top results. A citation counts as a match if it appears as a substring of the citation stored in Chroma's metadata (e.g. the expected citation 'Art. 17 GDPR' matches the stored citation 'Art. 17 GDPR — Right to erasure (‘right to be forgotten’)'). When a question lists more than one expected_citation, finding ANY one of them counts as a hit - used for topics genuinely covered by more than one rule (e.g. HIPAA's 'minimum necessary' standard appears in both § 164.502 and § 164.514).
